title: Big Fuel Deal, New Park Map, Health Orders
summary:
*   **Public Health:** Typhoid, typhus, and related fever diseases were declared reportable, requiring all city physicians to report cases to the City Physician, with penalties to be drafted for non-compliance.
*   **Pease Park Boundaries:** The official boundary lines for Pease Park were formally established and recorded, addressing the disappearance of original reference trees from its 1875 deed.
*   **City Utility Fuel:** A major contract was awarded to Ryan & Perry for lignite fuel to power the Water & Light Plant for 1914.
*   **Temporary Public Signs:** The Beiderwolf Tabernacle people were granted temporary permission to place up to six "A" signs in public areas until January 1, 1914.

Councilman Powell offered the following resolution : Linss Pease Park ✓ Whereas, on May
20th ,A D 1875, E M Pease and Wife, duly conveyed by deed Establishment to the City of
Austin, 23 acres,more or less, for use as a pleasure park, the-bon boundary lines of which
,together with certain reference trees, being clearly described in said deed; and,
Whereas, in the course of time, said reference trees have been removed or des-troyed, and
have disappeared, and their places cannot now be accurately located, and it having become
necessary to clearly define the outline of said Pease Park, including the portions
bordering upon Windsor Road and the Pease estate; Therefore, Be it resolved by the City
Council of the City of Austin : That the boundary line of said Park be agreed upon
,determined and established as follows: Beginning at a monument on the easterly side of
Windsor Road ,or Avenue, at the most northerly corner of Lot No 2 on the map attached to
the original deed of conveyance ,dated May 20th 1875.
Thence North 45 degrees,57 minutes west along the northerly side of said road 665 feet to
a monument. Thence N 24 degrees,17 minutes west along said road, 453 feet to a monument.
Thence still along said road N.32 degrees, 42 minutes west369 7/10 feet to a monument

feet , more or less, to a monument. Thence N 59 degrees,30 minutes west 520 feet to a
monumentand thence N 67 degrees,30 minutes west 500 feet to the place of beginning. All as
shown on map attached to this resolution , and to be recorded therewith.

Anthony, Bartholomew, Haynes & Powell 5 Nays none

Mayor Wooldridge offered the following resolution : Be it resolved by the City Council of
the City of Austin : That typhoid, typhus and allied fever diseases of these types, be and
the same are hereby declared to be reportable diseases.
Be it further resolved:
Physician Ordered
to report diseases
That the Physicians of the City of Austin are hereby directed and instructed to report all
cases of typhoid, typhus or allied fever diseases of these classes coming under their
personal care and treatment to the City Physician. N.B. for balance of resolutions seeX
